d:
The art book "Tim Burton's Film 'Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children'" in Russian.
This book tells the story of the filming of "Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children"—a remarkable tale of love and family, time travel, and strange abilities that captured the hearts of millions of viewers. You'll see stunning stills from the film, behind-the-scenes photos, concept art, costume sketches, portraits of the peculiar children and adults, and read exclusive interviews with the actors and crew.
n: [Non-H] The Art of Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children
